'''Kicking It from Here into Tomorrow!''' (Japanese: '''ヒバニー、炎のキック！明日に向かって！！''' ''{{tt|Hibanny|Scorunny}}, Use Your Flaming Kick! Face Tomorrow!!'') is the sixth chapter of the {{ma|Pokémon Journeys}} manga. It is based on the [[JN017|animated series episode by the same name]].

==Plot==
{{Incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* [[Goh]] is revealed to have {{pkmn2|caught}} a {{TP|Goh|Darmanitan}}.
* Goh's {{p|Scorbunny}} learns {{m|Ember}} and [[Evolution|evolves]] into {{TP|Goh|Raboot}}.

===Debuts===
====Pokémon debuts====
* {{p|Raboot}} ({{OP|Goh|Raboot}})
* {{p|Darmanitan}} ({{OP|Goh|Darmanitan}})
* {{p|Poliwrath}}

===Pokémon===
* {{p|Pikachu}} ({{OP|Ash|Pikachu}})
* {{p|Meowth}} ({{TRM}})

* {{p|Darmanitan}} ({{OP|Goh|Darmanitan}}; {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Darmanitan|Standard Mode}})

* {{p|Chewtle}} ([[Rocket Prize Master|Team Rocket's]])
* {{p|Poliwrath}} ([[Rocket Prize Master|Team Rocket's]])

==Differences between the animated series and the manga==
* The scene of {{TRT}} playing "{{m|Nasty Plot}} Shiritori" is omitted.
* As the events of ''[[JN003|Ivysaur's Mysterious Tower!]]'' were skipped, Goh first encounters Team Rocket here.
